title: Gandugali Kumara Rama
desc: Kumararama, son of King Deva Raya, is exiled by his stepmother. However, he strives to overcome the challenges that life throws at him.

title: My Dear Bootham
desc: A young boy, who struggles at school after his father died, finds a lantern in a cave that releases Karkimuki, the king of all genies that only he can seem to see.

title: Drishya 2
desc: Haunted by the guilt over the murder, Rajendra and his family are thrown into chaos when new clues surface, forcing them into a desperate race to evade the police.

title: Band Melam
desc: Childhood friends, Giri and Raaji separate due to different life choices. While she pursues education, he follows music with his village band, but later they reunite.

title: Sawaal
desc: Rai, the biggest crime boss, faces a dilemma when his daughter falls in love with a police officer and wants to marry him.

title: Take It Easy
desc: Dhanraj, a middle-class man, and his family struggle to navigate through their financial issues. Soon, he sets out on a quest to buy a car despite not being able to afford it.

title: Aaradhane
desc: A religious leader performs sacred rituals and worships the idol of a Hindu deity while chanting holy hymns to seek divine blessings.

title: Veera Ranachandi
desc: An underworld criminal, mistaken for a village chief's long-lost daughter, undergoes a profound transformation. This new-found identity empowers her to address the challenges faced by her community.
